name: Safarkhata
what: Travel and Umrah agencies manage leads, bookings, installments, passports, visas and supplier dues, and each customer gets a status link for what they paid and owe.
hard_part: Money paths are race-safe and idempotent: a live suite fires 20 simultaneous confirmations of one payment and gets exactly one ledger row, and 15 parallel bookings for 3 seats yield exactly 3. Business rules (installments, commission clawback, refund tiers, passport validity, parsing bKash/Nagad SMS) sit in a pure, table-tested package.
facts: 75 Go tests + 12 live end-to-end HTTP tests, 0 data races
Customer status page masks passports and never shows cost or profit
Separate permissions for owner, sales agents, accountant and ops
